**Notes & Limitations:**
- This list covers major grid-connected thermal facilities. It excludes small industrial backup generators, biomass, waste-to-energy, and decommissioned units.
- COD (Commercial Operation Date) reflects official commissioning or targeted launch dates per MOIT/EVN project tracking. Actual dates may shift by 6–18 months due to financing, permitting, or grid readiness.
- Coal plants are currently under phase-down per Vietnam's PDP8 and COP28 commitments, but remain operational under 20–30 year PPAs until retirement.
- Local natural gas plants are primarily fueled by domestic offshore fields (Bach Ho, Son Do, etc.). LNG plants rely on imported regasification terminals and are still in early development stages.
- For real-time project status, refer to MOIT's Annual Power Development Report, EVN's Project Investment Board, and the PDP8 approved plan (Decision No. 500/QD-TTg).
